sections.heading: NimbusKey Pro — FIDO2/WebAuthn Hardware Security Key

content.text: FIDO2/WebAuthn/U2F/OTP hardware authenticator with USB-C and NFC connectivity. List price $149.00 — in stock, ships within 2 business days.

NimbusKey Pro is a hardware authenticator supporting FIDO2, WebAuthn, U2F, and OTP, targeting engineers and security teams who need phishing-resistant MFA across cloud consoles, source control, and VPN endpoints. Private keys are generated and stored in a secure element and never leave the device.
Physical presence is required for every authentication event, mitigating remote credential theft even on a fully compromised host. The device is rated IP68 and built for daily keyring carry.
Physical: 45 x 18 x 4 mm, 3.4 g. Operating range -20°C to 60°C. 3-year warranty.
Quick-start: register NimbusKey Pro as a second factor with your identity provider and provision a backup key stored in a separate location.

items: Insert into a free USB-C port or tap via NFC
Register the key in your identity provider security settings
Provision a second NimbusKey Pro as backup and store it separately
